description: This file defines the UserRoleManagerHelper class, a helper utility within the HRM system that manages user role and permission data, including fetching data group permissions related to employees and permission collections, as well as utility functions for access control checks.

classes.name: UserRoleManagerHelper
classes.description: A helper class that provides methods for managing user roles and permissions, including retrieving data group permissions and permission collections, checking access rights, and determining if an employee is the current user.

methods.name: getUserRoleManager
methods.description: Retrieves the current user role manager instance from the dependency container.

methods.name: getEntityIndependentDataGroupPermissions
methods.description: Returns permissions for given data groups without considering any specific employee or entity.

methods.name: geEntityIndependentDataGroupPermissionCollection
methods.description: Returns a collection of data group permissions filtered only by data groups, ignoring employee-specific context.

methods.name: getDataGroupPermissionsForEmployee
methods.description: Retrieves data group permissions for a specific employee identified by employee number.

methods.name: getDataGroupPermissionCollectionForEmployee
methods.description: Retrieves a permission collection for a list of data groups, scoped to a specific employee.

methods.name: isSelfByEmpNumber
methods.description: Checks whether the provided employee number matches the logged-in user's employee number, indicating self-access.

methods.name: isEmployeeAccessible
methods.description: Determines if an employee's data is accessible either via entity permissions or if the employee is the current user.
